messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "if one form suits you better than the other, tell your doctor"
set: ["if one form suits you better than the other, tell your doctor", "tell your doctor if you also use", "tell your doctor if you have diabetes", "tell your doctor if you eat or drink less than usual", "one form of metoprolol", "tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria (PKU)", "tell your doctor right away if you feel more tired than usual", "combination provides better pain relief than one medicine by itself", "tell your doctor if you have a planned surgery", "tell your doctor if you have type 2 diabetes", "tell your doctor if you are of chinese descent", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding", "tell your doctor if you have a thyroid disorder", "tell your doctor if you have ever had anemia", "tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding a baby", "tell your doctor if you have ever had diabetes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
